english.note: Use this when the speaker is specifically making fun of or putting down themself.

examples.english: I said deprecatingly, joking at my own expense, “I’m all grown up, but I can’t even cook noodles without burning them.”
examples.traditional: 我自嘲咁話：「我咁大個人，連煮個麵都煮燶。」
